title: School Nutrition Calendar Memo: Serving Days Counted in a Prepayment Quote on the School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
The serving days a prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts run from the day after the quote date through the end of the calendar month after it: the serving days left in the month of the quote date together with the serving days of the calendar month after it.

The district's 2026-27 calendar serves meals on every weekday from August 12, 2026 through May 27, 2027, except Labor Day (September 7), October 12, the Thanksgiving week (November 23 through 27), the winter break (December 21 through January 1), January 18, February 15, the spring break (March 15 through 19) and March 26, and it serves no meals in June or July.

The serving days a prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts left in the month of the quote date are the weekdays after the quote date through the last day of that month on which that calendar serves meals, less the calendar's closures that fall among them; a quote date before August 12, 2026 counts from August 12, 2026, and a quote date in July 2026 or after May 27, 2027 leaves none.

## Serving days of the month after

| Month of the quote date | Serving days of the calendar month after it |
|---|---|
| July 2026 | 14 (August) |
| August 2026 | 21 (September) |
| September 2026 | 21 (October) |
| October 2026 | 16 (November) |
| November 2026 | 14 (December) |
| December 2026 | 19 (January) |
| January 2027 | 19 (February) |
| February 2027 | 17 (March) |
| March 2027 | 22 (April) |
| April 2027 | 19 (May) |
| May 2027 | none (June) |
| June 2027 | none (July) |

For a quote date outside July 2026 through June 2027 the serving days a prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account counts are twenty (20): no serving day is left in its month on that calendar, and twenty are counted for the month after.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Quote date | Left in its month | Month after | Serving days counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuesday, April 20, 2027 | 8 (April 21 to 23 and April 26 to 30) | 19 | 27 |
| Wednesday, November 18, 2026 | 3 (November 19, 20 and 30; the Thanksgiving week is closed) | 14 | 17 |
| Wednesday, August 5, 2026 | 14 (counted from August 12 through August 31) | 21 | 35 |
| Friday, May 28, 2027 | none (after May 27, 2027) | none | 0 |
| Tuesday, July 6, 2027 | outside July 2026 through June 2027 | — | 20 |
